title: SwyHub Auto Farm Auto Upgrade Live Session and More
features:
🧪 SwyHub — Slime RNG 🌈

Master the slime-collecting universe with the ultimate Slime RNG automation suite. Built for power and efficiency, this script delivers a high-performance experience with our signature premium interface.

🛠️ Main Features:

🌀 Advanced RNG Automation: • Auto Roll & Fast Roll: Bypasses cooldowns and automates the rolling process for maximum efficiency. • Auto Rebirth: Automatically restarts your progress when requirements are met to scale your multipliers. • Auto Claim Rewards: Never miss a milestone by automatically collecting all Slime Index rewards.

📈 Intelligent Upgrade Engine: • Full Automation: Automatically purchases upgrades for Coins, Multiplier, Speed, Luck, and Bag Space. • Smart Resource Management: Optimized to prioritize the most efficient upgrades first.

📦 Inventory & World Utilities: • Auto Use Items: Keeps your luck and speed buffs active by automatically consuming potions and items. • World Collector: Automatically sweeps the map for Coins, Chests, and hidden collectibles.

🚀 Mobility & Physics: • Fly Mode: Precise 6-axis movement with customizable speed sliders for perfect navigation. • Physics Overrides: Instant adjustments for WalkSpeed, Jump Power, and Gravity to dominate the environment.

🌍 Session Management: • Live Statistics: Track your recently obtained slimes and total coins directly on the UI with real-time updates. • Server Tools: Quick Server Hop and Rejoin features to maintain your flow during gameplay.

⚠️ Active Development: Constantly updated with the latest game patches and performance optimizations to ensure you stay ahead of the leaderboard.
